user.title: Connect SCPI Power Supply
user.description: Select the serial device or enter a remote serial URI (`socket://host:port`, `rfc2217://host:port`, or `esphome://...`).

confirm.title: Configure {model}
confirm.description: Successfully connected to {model} (Serial Number: {serial_number}, Firmware: {firmware}). You may customize the device name or configure optional safety clamps.

data_description.max_voltage_clamp: Hard upper ceiling enforced in both UI controls and SCPI commands (`VOLT` and `VOLT:LIM` / `VOLT:PROT`). Leave empty to use the model's hardware rating.
data_description.max_current_clamp: Hard upper ceiling enforced in both UI controls and SCPI commands (`CURR` and `CURR:LIM` / `CURR:PROT`). Leave empty to use the model's hardware rating.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect or query the power supply at the specified serial URI.

abort.already_configured: This power supply is already configured.

init.title: SCPI Power Supply Options
init.description: Update connection parameters, polling interval, or hardware safety clamps.

data_description.max_voltage_clamp: Hard upper ceiling enforced in both UI controls and SCPI commands (`VOLT` and `VOLT:LIM` / `VOLT:PROT`). Clear to use the model's hardware rating.
data_description.max_current_clamp: Hard upper ceiling enforced in both UI controls and SCPI commands (`CURR` and `CURR:LIM` / `CURR:PROT`). Clear to use the model's hardware rating.
